description: This file contains shell script code for configuring and managing a 'unet' protocol in a network device environment. It includes functions for initializing configuration, setting up and tearing down network interfaces, and interfacing with external components such as ubus and ip link.

methods.name: proto_unet_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the configuration parameters for the unet protocol.

methods.name: proto_unet_setup
methods.description: Sets up the unet network interface based on provided configuration variables.

methods.name: proto_unet_teardown
methods.description: Removes the unet network interface and cleans up configuration.
